jobs.title: GTM Recruiter
jobs.description: <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote </p> <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Why AssemblyAI</strong></h3> <p>AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.</p> <p>We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.</p> <p>If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>AssemblyAI is building the leading Voice AI infrastructure platform, and our go-to-market team is growing fast. We’re looking for a GTM Recruiter to help us hire the Account Executives, BDRs, Customer Success, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Marketers who bring our models to developers and enterprises around the world.</p> <p>You’ll own a portfolio of GTM reqs from first conversation to signed offer, working closely with our GTM Recruiting Lead and hiring managers across Sales, Customer Solutions, and Marketing. It’s a high-volume, high-bar role: we’re hiring a lot of people, and every one of them needs to be great.</p> <p>AI is one of the most competitive talent markets in tech. Great GTM people have a lot of options, and many of them aren’t actively looking. This role is about finding them, starting real conversations, and showing them why AssemblyAI is worth the move.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own full-cycle recruiting for 5-6 open GTM roles at a time, from intake and sourcing through offer and close</li> <li>Source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, referrals, communities, events, and AI-assisted tools&nbsp;</li> <li>Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate market research, craft tailored candidate messaging, and optimize workflow velocity</li> <li>Run Zoom screens that assess for what matters in each role (pipeline generation, technical fluency, coachability) and share crisp, decision-ready feedback</li> <li>Partner with hiring managers to calibrate profiles, run interview loops in Greenhouse, and keep decisions moving</li> <li>Manage offers end to end, including OTE and commission conversations, competing offers, and closing</li> <li>Keep Greenhouse clean and current so the team can trust
